definitions.exceptional: exemplary use of existing approaches that establish new standards for a field
definitions.compelling: evidence that features methods, data and analyses more rigorous than the current state-of-the-art
definitions.convincing: appropriate and validated methodology in line with current state-of-the-art
definitions.solid: methods, data and analyses broadly support the claims with only minor weaknesses
definitions.incomplete: main claims are only partially supported
definitions.inadequate: methods, data and analyses do not support the primary claims

selection_policy.after_possible_billing: Preserve the attempt, reconcile its charge, then request a separately bounded retry; never automatic fallback POST.
selection_policy.before_generation: Use existing selector and only current task-accepted compatible routes; preserve quality, family, effort and complete inputs.
selection_policy.new_models: Terra, Kimi and new gateway/model versions remain scoped candidates until their actual task evidence is accepted.
selection_policy.normal_review: Read existing receipts and free catalog/quote observations; no extra model judge or recurring paid probe.

dynamic_decision.reason: approved baseline; no unverified route is tried

scope: Published life-science evidence categories assessed from complete primary API text; linked media not visually assessed. Full-primary judgments do not validate the three-view workflow, numeric scores, other domains, independence or acceptance probability.
